findings.observation: Checkpoint v1 records abandoned live episodes and accepts only fresh_env resume; Adam and global RNG are present.
findings.successor_requirement: Versioned full VecEnv/core RNG/feature History/adapter/cached-observation/action-phase serialization and exact continuation qualification.

findings.observation: Recovery stores model/Adam/RNG plus episode metadata, explicitly no full environment state or automatic resume. Final checkpoint omits runtime/RNG state.
findings.successor_requirement: Every completed update must commit full state and a durable journal anchor; old artifacts cannot reconstruct lost live games.

findings.observation: Existing atomic no-replace publication fsyncs file/directory and preserves failed partials; no atomic state-plus-journal transaction here.
findings.successor_requirement: Qualify a crash-consistent manifest commit over state, telemetry, schedule and cumulative wall accounting; preserve torn writes as incidents.

findings.observation: Python VecDodgeEnv exposes step/reset/observation/metadata APIs, not full-wrapper snapshot/restore.
findings.successor_requirement: Core snapshot alone is insufficient: include per-slot feature history, indices, pending resets and held-action phase; no reset at monitoring barriers.

findings.observation: make_optimizer constructs fixed-LR Adam; same-phase restart is explicitly disabled without parent cumulative-budget authority.
findings.successor_requirement: Separately reviewed scheduler-aware successor and parent budget/phase protocol; do not weaken old guards or infer retry authority.

findings.observation: Actual formal PreparedUpdates validates constant Adam LR/epsilon. Its scheduler_reference is a curriculum assignment scheduler, not an LR scheduler.
findings.successor_requirement: Validate registered LR/entropy schedule state each update and restore, preserving epsilon and independent PPO stop controls.

findings.observation: PPO computes epoch/final KL, entropy, value loss, explained variance, clip fraction and gradients. EV is undefined for near-zero target variance; GAE runs once.
findings.successor_requirement: Persist original definitions and null/definedness. Log raw pre-normalization advantage scale and switches; do not claim PPO lacks existing metrics.

findings.observation: Formal journal keeps counts/epochs/early-stop booleans but discards numerical KL/entropy/value/EV/clip metrics.
findings.successor_requirement: Exactly one complete identity-bound telemetry row per committed update, including valid closing partials, with counters and weighted denominators.

findings.observation: Synthetic-tested adapter logs KL/entropy/value/GAE moments/switches, but omits EV/clip fraction and expects one GAE call.
findings.successor_requirement: New capsule adds EV/clip fields, schedule/frame clocks and optional per-epoch refresh contract; qualify against real PPO and passive parity.

findings.observation: Terminal evaluator loads a separate model but reseeds Python/NumPy/Torch/MPS global RNG. This is valid terminal evaluation, not isolated training interleaving.
findings.successor_requirement: Dedicated evaluation process plus full training suspension/checkpoint; prove no training RNG/model/Adam/env/history/module-flag mutation.

findings.observation: Base evaluator reuses 64 development seeds and argmax actions; restoring model.train flag does not implement rotating1024-seed sampled-K1 monitoring.
findings.successor_requirement: Registered disjoint cohorts, fixed common controller, exact counts and strict terminal acceptance before reading outcomes.

findings.observation: Native tuple-hash stream supports exclusions but finite u32 seeds can collide; formal campaign used the fixed pool.
findings.successor_requirement: Fresh non-pool stream excludes all historic/held-out allocations, deduplicates training starts within each replica, logs rejections/indices, fails on exhaustion; paired replicas may share their registered training seed sequence.

findings.observation: Existing worker guards work time, lease and RSS/MPS independently; larger batches, two replicas and full snapshots were not qualified by this run.
findings.successor_requirement: Keep6GiB separate ceilings and one MPS job; qualify aggregate observer/child RSS, MPS peaks, I/O, disk reserve, AC guard and full budget forecast.

scope: Read-only source and accepted receipts only; no model load, games, optimizer steps, imports of RL code or launches.
